description: Current official Hong Kong private-lot WFS 1.1 contract, paced complete reads and rejected wrapper paths.
scope: Lands Department iC1000 private-lot index only. Government Land Allocations and Short-Term Tenancies are separate collections and are not enabled here. Native lotid is distinct from transport WFS FID and the displayed lot name. Only bounded Hong Kong entry enabled; boundaries are indicative, not legal survey proof.

identity.transportFeatureId: lot_lotindexapi.<row> is used only for repeated-page detection
identity.featureVersion: lastupdatedate, sampled2023-12-12, not a dataset publication date

licence.reuse: Commercial and non-commercial copying permitted with Government/CSDI attribution; API requires Lands Department logo and copyright on map face

adapterContract.protocol: Explicit WFS1.1.0 GeoJSON; maxFeatures,startIndex,sortBy=lotid; numeric totalFeatures required and stable across pages
adapterContract.paging: Repeated transport IDs, conflicting ground geometry, missing/changing counts or truncated pages fail closed
adapterContract.outputCrs: CRS:84 requested; returned coordinates verified longitude/latitude
adapterContract.requestPacing: One request at a time per fixed endpoint across adapter instances, starts at least1000ms apart; queued wait is outside the upstream15s timeout

failedAttempts.operation: Percent-encoded bbox commas on GML wrapper
failedAttempts.detail: Literal documented bbox succeeded with two lots; URLSearchParams-style encoded commas were rejected.
This endpoint exposes WFS1.1, so2.0 count/typeNames path is not used.
